scientific_statement: Within the fixed-context restricted-domain emulator experiment, intrinsic branch medians depend more strongly on regularization and declared hidden-spin completion than on the tested bank/search replacements. This is not a measurement of cosmic formation fractions or general robustness.
limits: Fixed birth spin and CE efficiency; no hyperparameter inference or physical-model uncertainty marginalization.
Conditional spin laws are additional assumptions absent from the four-dimensional channel products.
Historical injection reference, hopeless screening and PE prior-excluded likelihood remain unverified.
Normalizers are finite emulator MC estimates, not known exact numbers.
Continuous flow behavior near zero spin and CE context interpretation remain diagnosed limitations.
No ESS-based deletion of rows or events; concentration diagnostics are not campaign coverage calibration.
Low weight concentration is retained: fixed-bank channel posteriors are not calibrated campaign or PE-chain estimates.
Regularized detected labels include a shared artificial density term; the decomposition must not be reported as observed astrophysical membership.
